catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds an acknowledged Gazebo DeleteModel operation. cap.motion.stop.v1 requires a repeatable stopped-state report, while the DeleteModel response only acknowledges deletion of the named model and reports success=false once the model is absent.

No catalogue class binds a fixed std_msgs/Int16 scene-setup publication. cap.world.reset.v1 requires an observation and a seed, but the plugin's respawn callback uses std::rand/time and std::random_device and exposes no seed control; cap.world.seed.v1 therefore does not fit either. The publication carries no execution acknowledgement.

No catalogue class binds a fixed std_msgs/Int16 scene-regeneration publication. cap.world.reset.v1 requires an observation and a seed, but the plugin randomises labels and counts with time and std::random_device and exposes no seed control; the topic publication has no acknowledgement.

No catalogue class binds the one-shot std_msgs/Bool barrier-removal publication. cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.step.v1 act on a world and return observation/seed/state-hash values the plugin does not publish; the unblock topic is a bare Bool with no application response.

No catalogue class binds a general Gazebo DeleteModel service with a caller-supplied model name. cap.motion.stop.v1 requires a stopped-state report, and the DeleteModel response only acknowledges deletion of one named model.

No catalogue class carries a raw nav_msgs/Odometry world observation. cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque resources, not a world.sim resource; cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 is a bounded motion command with distance/heading/stopped outputs, not an observation.

No catalogue class carries a visualization_msgs/MarkerArray scene-observation. The markers are simulation scene metadata, not a sensor reading; no sensing class accepts an unbounded marker array or a world.sim resource.

Deleting planar_box is not a stop and cannot be undone without relaunching the world; delete_model can delete any model, including jackal. /box_odom is a ground-truth topic the README forbids for the student task. Unblocking needs an acknowledged stop the clone references (for example a Gazebo pause service) or an SDK profile for world-edit callbacks without cancellation.
